data.name: Engineer Facilities / Principal Engineer Facilities
data.jobDescription:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: None

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Job Description

Northrop Grumman is currently seeking an experienced Facility Engineer - level 2 or 3 to provide leadership to our Defense Group team in our Ronkonkoma, NY offices.

The position will be filled to either a level 2 or level 3 depending upon demonstrated education, experience, and competency.

Overview:

Leadership and oversight of facility equipment and maintenance.

Supports compliance with federal, state, and local regulations pertaining to environmental safety.

Performs duties in compliance with AS9100 Rev D, addressing design, manufacturing, integration, and test activities.

Interfaces with customers, vendors, and with NG Manufacturing, Integration & Test and Engineering organizations to ensure facilities support identify and resolve operational shortcomings and improvements. 

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Management of capital projects to schedule and budget.
  • Identify cost reduction opportunities within facility operations.
  • Maintain Facilities documentation and Share Point site.
  • Develop and oversee annual facility maintenance schedule
  • Active participation on Facility IPT Team.
  • Proactively seek out improvements for the facility.
  • Be and advocate for change
  • Participate in safety audits to ensure implemented precautions are being followed.
  • Lead design reviews for new and modified facilities, processes, equipment, and tooling.
  • Assist in accident/incident investigation to help determine causes and corrective actions as needed.
  • Works within and provides improvements to Quality Assurance programs, AS9100 D procedures and controls ensuring that products and services conform to company standards of excellence.
  • Supports the development, implementation and maintenance of quality policy and procedures. Interfaces with suppliers in the verification of product design and reliability.
  • Reviews practices, procedures and processes seeking avenues to improve efficiency and effectiveness and reduce risk to product quality.
  • Interprets customer technical requirements, ensuring these requirements are integrated into program plans, specifications and product drawings.
  • Provide input in discrepancy review, failure investigations, as well as cause and corrective action determinations. Analyze and interpret trends and executes improvements on key metrics.
  • Ensure program contract requirements are flowed down internally and to suppliers.
  • Performs Root Cause and Problem Solving projects.
  • Conducts internal audits to demonstrate compliance.

Requirements for level 2:

  • U.S. Citizenship
  • Requires BS in STEM and two years of experience.  Will consider those with a MS in STEM and zero years of experience.
  • Possess a valid Professional Engineering (PE) License. Desired but not required.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a team player.
  • Strong Project Management skills.
  • Excellent problem solving, written and verbal communications skills.
  • Self-disciplined and able to work independently
  • Knowledge of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code
  • Ability to prioritize a variety of activities for timely response and results
  • Able to read engineering documentation and inspect drawings and parts lists, inspection plans, and supplemental instructions.
  • Understanding and application of safety regulations, standards, principles, theories, and techniques.
  • Competent in the use of the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook). 
  • Solid modeling experience. Pro E / Unigraphics / AutoCAD

Requirements for level 3:

  • U.S. Citizenship
  • Requires BS in STEM and five years of experience.  Will consider those with a MS in STEM and three years of experience.
  • Possess a valid Professional Engineering (PE) License. Desired but not required.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a team player.
  • Strong Project Management skills.
  • Excellent problem solving, written and verbal communications skills.
  • Self-disciplined and able to work independently
  • Knowledge of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code
  • Ability to prioritize a variety of activities for timely response and results
  • Able to read engineering documentation and inspect drawings and parts lists, inspection plans, and supplemental instructions.
  • Understanding and application of safety regulations, standards, principles, theories, and techniques.
  • Competent in the use of the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook). 
  • Solid modeling experience. Pro E / Unigraphics / AutoCAD

Preferred Qualifications for both levels:

  • Experience in lean manufacturing
  • Experience in aerospace industry

Primary Level Salary Range: $83,400.00 - $125,200.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $103,600.00 - $155,400.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
